name: operator split method
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 将耦合更新过程分解为若干子算子求解的方法。
usage_overview: 用于材料本构计算中的状态更新。在考虑混凝土疲劳损伤的列车—轨道长期演化模型中，将更新过程分为弹性预测、塑性修正和损伤修正，逐步处理材料状态的变化。

complete_examples.text: In the numerical calculation of the elastoplastic damage constitutive model, an operator split method is widely recognized as effective [65–66], which algorithm includes three steps, elastic trial, plastic-corrector and damage-corrector step.
